Paquete `ddqpu` (embebido, versión de `src/ddqpu`)","metadata":{}},{"id":"da7906c9","cell_type":"code","source":"import pathlib, sys\n_FILES = {}\n_FILES['__init__.py'] = '\"\"\"ddqpu: validacion de Dynamical Decoupling en QPU IBM con control de relevos.\"\"\"\\n__version__ = \"5.0.0\"\\nfrom .circuits import *  # noqa\\nfrom .analysis import *  # noqa\\nfrom .backend_utils import *  # noqa\\nfrom .experiment import *  # noqa\\nfrom . import sentinel  # noqa\\n'\n_FILES['analysis.py'] = '\"\"\"Analisis offline: mitigacion de lectura, coherencia en cuadratura, ajustes ponderados,\\nestadistica de relevos (prueba pareada) y shift ZZ por espectadores.\"\"\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport math\\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional, Sequence\\n\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom scipy.optimize import curve_fit\\nfrom scipy.stats import norm\\n\\n\\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- conteos\\ndef counts_from_pub(pub) -> dict:\\n    data = pub.data\\n    for key in (\"c\", \"meas\"):\\n        if hasattr(data, key):\\n            return getattr(data, key).get_counts()\\n    for key in data:\\n        try:\\n            return data[key].get_counts()\\n        except Exception:\\n            continue\\n    return {}\\n\\n\\ndef bit_counts(counts: dict, bit: int):\\n    \"\"\"(n0, n1) para el bit clasico `bit` (0 = el de la derecha).\"\"\"\\n    n0 = n1 = 0\\n    for k, v in counts.items():\\n        b = str(k).replace(\" \", \"\")[-1 - bit]\\n        if b == \"0\":\\n            n0 += int(v)\\n        else:\\n            n1 += int(v)\\n    return n0, n1\\n\\n\\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- lectura\\ndef readout_errors(cal0: dict, cal1: dict, n_bits: int):\\n    \"\"\"e0[b] = P(1|0), e1[b] = P(0|1) por qubit, desde los circuitos de calibracion del mismo job.\"\"\"\\n    e0, e1 = [], []\\n    for b in range(n_bits):\\n        a0, a1 = bit_counts(cal0, b)\\n        c0, c1 = bit_counts(cal1, b)\\n        e0.append(a1 / max(a0 + a1, 1))\\n        e1.append(c0 / max(c0 + c1, 1))\\n    return np.array(e0), np.array(e1)\\n\\n\\ndef mitigated_expectation(counts: dict, bit: int, e0: float, e1: float):\\n    \"\"\"<Z> corregido por matriz de asignacion 1q y su error estandar.\"\"\"\\n    n0, n1 = bit_counts(counts, bit)\\n    n = max(n0 + n1, 1)\\n    pm1 = n1 / n\\n    denom = max(1.0 - e0 - e1, 0.5)\\n    p1 = float(np.clip((pm1 - e0) / denom, 0.0, 1.0))\\n    ez = 1.0 - 2.0 * p1\\n    se = 2.0 * math.sqrt(max(pm1 * (1 - pm1), 1.0 / n) / n) / denom\\n    return ez, se\\n\\n\\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- coherencia\\ndef coherence_from_xy(x, y, sx, sy):\\n    \"\"\"|rho01| = sqrt(<X>^2 + <Y>^2) con correccion de sesgo por ruido de disparo, y fase.\"\"\"\\n    x, y, sx, sy = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (x, y, sx, sy))\\n    mag2 = x ** 2 + y ** 2 - (sx ** 2 + sy ** 2)\\n    mag = np.sqrt(np.clip(mag2, 0.0, None))\\n    se = np.sqrt((x * sx) ** 2 + (y * sy) ** 2) / np.maximum(mag, 1e-3)\\n    se = np.maximum(se, np.sqrt(0.5 * (sx ** 2 + sy ** 2)))\\n    phase = np.arctan2(y, x)\\n    return mag, se, phase\\n\\n\\ndef stretched(t, A, T2, beta):\\n    return A * np.exp(-((np.maximum(t, 0.0) / T2) ** beta))\\n\\n\\ndef fit_envelope(t, y, se, beta_fixed: Optional[float] = None, label: str = \"\") -> Optional[dict]:\\n    \"\"\"Ajuste ponderado A*exp(-(t/T2)^beta) con C = 0 (fisicamente, la coherencia decae a 0).\\n    Fijar C elimina la degeneracion T2<->C que producia barras de error > valor en v1-v3.\\n    El error se infla por sqrt(chi2_red) cuando hay deriva temporal (chi2_red > 1).\"\"\"\\n    t, y, se = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (t, y, se))\\n    ok = np.isfinite(y) & np.isfinite(se)\\n    t, y, se = t[ok], y[ok], np.maximum(se[ok], 1e-3)\\n    if len(t) < 3 or np.nanmax(y) < 0.05:\\n        return None\\n    # T0 inicial: primer cruce por 1/e\\n    below = np.where(y < y[0] / math.e)[0]\\n    T0 = float(t[below[0]]) if len(below) else float(t[-1] * 2)\\n    try:\\n        if beta_fixed is None:\\n            f = stretched\\n            p0, lo, hi = [min(y[0], 1.0), T0, 1.0], [0.0, 0.5, 0.5], [1.2, 20 * t[-1], 3.0]\\n        else:\\n            f = lambda tt, A, T2: stretched(tt, A, T2, beta_fixed)  # noqa: E731\\n            p0, lo, hi = [min(y[0], 1.0), T0], [0.0, 0.5], [1.2, 20 * t[-1]]\\n        popt, pcov = curve_fit(f, t, y, p0=p0, sigma=se, absolute_sigma=True, bounds=(lo, hi), maxfev=20000)\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print(f\"Ajuste {label} fallo: {e}\")\\n        return None\\n    perr = np.sqrt(np.diag(pcov))\\n    dof = max(len(t) - len(popt), 1)\\n    chi2 = float(np.sum(((f(t, *popt) - y) / se) ** 2) / dof)\\n    infl = math.sqrt(max(chi2, 1.0))\\n    out = {\"A\": float(popt[0]), \"T2\": float(popt[1]), \"T2_err\": float(perr[1] * infl),\\n           \"beta\": float(popt[2]) if beta_fixed is None else float(beta_fixed),\\n           \"beta_err\": float(perr[2] * infl) if beta_fixed is None else 0.0,\\n           \"chi2_red\": chi2, \"n_points\": int(len(t))}\\n    out[\"reliable\"] = bool(out[\"T2_err\"] < 0.3 * out[\"T2\"] and t[-1] > 0.7 * out[\"T2\"])\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef detuning_from_phase(t, phase, mag, min_mag: float = 0.25, max_gap_us: float = 10.0):\\n    \"\"\"Frecuencia de detuning (kHz) por desenvolvimiento de fase en el tramo denso de la rejilla.\\n    Solo se usan puntos consecutivos con separacion <= max_gap_us (sin aliasing si |f| < 1/(2*gap)).\"\"\"\\n    t, phase, mag = map(lambda a: np.asarray(a, float), (t, phase, mag))\\n    sel = [0] if len(t) else []\\n    for i in range(1, len(t)):\\n        if mag[i] < min_mag or (t[i] - t[sel[-1]]) > max_gap_us:\\n            break\\n        sel.append(i)\\n    if len(sel) < 3:\\n        return None\\n    ts, ph = t[sel], np.unwrap(phase[sel])\\n    A = np.vstack([ts, np.ones_like(ts)]).T\\n    coef, res, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, ph, rcond=None)\\n    slope = coef[0]\\n    resid = ph - A @ coef\\n    s2 = float(np.sum(resid ** 2) / max(len(ts) - 2, 1))\\n    cov = s2 * np.linalg.inv(A.T @ A)\\n    f_khz = slope / (2 * math.pi) * 1e3\\n    f_err = math.sqrt(max(cov[0, 0], 0)) / (2 * math.pi) * 1e3\\n    return {\"f_kHz\": float(f_khz), \"f_err_kHz\": float(f_err), \"n_points\": len(sel),\\n            \"t_max_us\": float(ts[-1])}\\n\\n\\ndef ratio_with_err(a, ea, b, eb):\\n    r = a / b\\n    return r, abs(r) * math.sqrt((ea / a) ** 2 + (eb / b) ** 2)\\n\\n\\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- relevos\\ndef two_proportion_test(k1, n1, k0, n0):\\n    \"\"\"Diferencia de proporciones (p1 - p0), error, z, p-valor unilateral (p1 > p0)\\n    y cota superior al 95%.\"\"\"\\n    p1, p0 = k1 / max(n1, 1), k0 / max(n0, 1)\\n    p = (k1 + k0) / max(n1 + n0, 1)\\n    se_pool = math.sqrt(max(p * (1 - p), 1e-12) * (1 / max(n1, 1) + 1 / max(n0, 1)))\\n    se = math.sqrt(max(p1 * (1 - p1), 1 / max(n1, 1) ** 2) / max(n1, 1)\\n                   + max(p0 * (1 - p0), 1 / max(n0, 1) ** 2) / max(n0, 1))\\n    z = (p1 - p0) / se_pool if se_pool > 0 else 0.0\\n    return {\"delta\": p1 - p0, \"se\": se, \"z\": z, \"p_value\": float(1 - norm.cdf(z)),\\n            \"upper95\": (p1 - p0) + 1.645 * se, \"p_active\": p1, \"p_ref\": p0}\\n\\n\\ndef relay_statistics(records: List[dict], neighbor_bits: Sequence[int], control_bit: int) -> dict:\\n    \"\"\"records: dicts con \\'spec\\' (CircuitSpec dict) y \\'counts\\'.\\n    Compara P(1) de cada espectador cuando el objetivo esta activo (main, en |+>) o excitado (exc1)\\n    contra la referencia con objetivo inactivo (idle), agregando todos los circuitos.\"\"\"\\n    def pool(kinds, bit):\\n        k = n = 0\\n        for r in records:\\n            if r[\"spec\"][\"kind\"] in kinds:\\n                n0, n1 = bit_counts(r[\"counts\"], bit)\\n                k += n1\\n                n += n0 + n1\\n        return k, n\\n\\n    out = {}\\n    for label, bit in [*[(f\"vecino_bit{b}\", b) for b in neighbor_bits], (\"control\", control_bit)]:\\n        k_ref, n_ref = pool((\"idle\",), bit)\\n        k_act, n_act = pool((\"main\",), bit)\\n        k_exc, n_exc = pool((\"exc1\",), bit)\\n        out[label] = {\\n            \"activo_vs_idle\": two_proportion_test(k_act, n_act, k_ref, n_ref),\\n            \"excitado_vs_idle\": two_proportion_test(k_exc, n_exc, k_ref, n_ref),\\n            \"n_ref\": n_ref, \"n_act\": n_act, \"n_exc\": n_exc,\\n        }\\n    return out\\n\\n\\ndef relay_verdict(stats: dict, alpha: float = 0.01, max_transfer: float = 0.005) -> dict:\\n    \"\"\"Hay relevo si algun vecino muestra exceso de P(1) significativo (p < alpha, con correccion de\\n    Bonferroni) Y de magnitud relevante (> max_transfer). Si no, se reporta la cota superior.\"\"\"\\n    tests = [(lab, key, s[key]) for lab, s in stats.items() if lab.startswith(\"vecino\")\\n             for key in (\"activo_vs_idle\", \"excitado_vs_idle\")]\\n    m = max(len(tests), 1)\\n    flagged = [(lab, key, t) for lab, key, t in tests\\n               if t[\"p_value\"] < alpha / m and t[\"delta\"] > max_transfer]\\n    worst_upper = max((t[\"upper95\"] for _, _, t in tests), default=float(\"nan\"))\\n    return {\"relay_detected\": bool(flagged), \"flagged\": [(a, b) for a, b, _ in flagged],\\n            \"worst_upper95\": worst_upper, \"bonferroni_m\": m}\\n\\n\\n__all__ = [n for n in dir() if not n.startswith(\"_\")]\\n'\n_FILES['backend_utils.py'] = '\"\"\"Seleccion de qubits, layout de espectadores, transpilacion verificada y estimacion de tiempo QPU.\"\"\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport os\\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, asdict\\nfrom typing import Dict, List, Optional\\n\\nimport numpy as np\\n\\nTWO_Q_GATES = {\"cz\", \"ecr\", \"cx\", \"swap\", \"rzz\", \"iswap\", \"cy\", \"cp\", \"rzx\"}\\n\\n\\ndef get_token() -> str:\\n    try:\\n        from kaggle_secrets import UserSecretsClient  # type: ignore\\n        t = UserSecretsClient().get_secret(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\\n        if t:\\n            return t.strip()\\n    except Exception:\\n        pass\\n    t = os.environ.get(\"QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\") or os.environ.get(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\\n    if not t:\\n        raise RuntimeError(\"Configure el secreto IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN (Kaggle) o la variable QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\")\\n    return t.strip()\\n\\n\\ndef get_service(channel: str = \"ibm_cloud\", instance: Optional[str] = \"open-instance\"):\\n    \"\"\"Crea el servicio sin escribir el token en disco (save_account no es necesario en cada corrida).\"\"\"\\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService\\n    kw = {\"channel\": channel, \"token\": get_token()}\\n    if instance:\\n        kw[\"instance\"] = instance\\n    return QiskitRuntimeService(**kw)\\n\\n\\n@dataclass\\nclass QubitInfo:\\n    q: int\\n    t1_us: float\\n    t2_us: float\\n    sx_err: float\\n    ro_err: float\\n    score: float\\n\\n\\ndef _qubit_info(backend, q: int) -> Optional[QubitInfo]:\\n    tgt = backend.target\\n    try:\\n        qp = tgt.qubit_properties[q]\\n        t1 = (qp.t1 or 0.0) * 1e6\\n        t2 = (qp.t2 or 0.0) * 1e6\\n    except Exception:\\n        return None\\n    if t2 <= 0 or t1 <= 0:\\n        return None\\n\\n    def err(op):\\n        try:\\n            e = tgt[op][(q,)].error\\n            return float(e) if e is not None else None\\n        except Exception:\\n            return None\\n\\n    sx = err(\"sx\") or err(\"x\") or 1e-2\\n    ro = err(\"measure\") or 5e-2\\n    # T2 > 2*T1 no es fisico: calibracion sospechosa, se recorta\\n    t2_eff = min(t2, 2.0 * t1)\\n    score = t2_eff / (1.0 + 50.0 * sx + 10.0 * ro)\\n    return QubitInfo(q, t1, t2, sx, ro, score)\\n\\n\\ndef rank_qubits(backend, top: int = 8) -> List[QubitInfo]:\\n    rows = [r for q in range(backend.num_qubits) if (r := _qubit_info(backend, q))]\\n    rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r.score)\\n    return rows[:top] if top else rows\\n\\n\\ndef bfs_distances(backend, source: int) -> Dict[int, int]:\\n    adj: Dict[int, set] = {q: set() for q in range(backend.num_qubits)}\\n    for a, b in backend.coupling_map.get_edges():\\n        adj[a].add(b)\\n        adj[b].add(a)\\n    dist = {source: 0}\\n    frontier = [source]\\n    while frontier:\\n        nxt = []\\n        for u in frontier:\\n            for v in adj[u]:\\n                if v not in dist:\\n                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1\\n                    nxt.append(v)\\n        frontier = nxt\\n    return dist\\n\\n\\n@dataclass\\nclass Layout:\\n    target: int\\n    target_t2_us: float\\n    target_t1_us: float\\n    neighbors: List[int]\\n    control: int\\n    control_distance: int\\n\\n    @property\\n    def physical(self) -> List[int]:\\n        return [self.target] + list(self.neighbors) + [self.control]\\n\\n    def to_dict(self):\\n        d = asdict(self)\\n        d[\"physical\"] = self.physical\\n        return d\\n\\n\\ndef choose_layout(backend, force_target: Optional[int] = None, n_neighbors: int = 2,\\n                  min_control_distance: int = 4) -> Layout:\\n    ranked = rank_qubits(backend, top=0)\\n    info = {r.q: r for r in ranked}\\n    if force_target is not None:\\n        tq = int(force_target)\\n    else:\\n        tq = ranked[0].q\\n    ti = info.get(tq) or _qubit_info(backend, tq)\\n    dist = bfs_distances(backend, tq)\\n    nbs = sorted([q for q, d in dist.items() if d == 1], key=lambda q: -(info[q].score if q in info else 0))\\n    if not nbs:\\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"q{tq} no tiene vecinos en el mapa de acoplamiento\")\\n    # Se miden TODOS los vecinos directos disponibles hasta n_neighbors (en heavy-hex son 2-3)\\n    nbs = nbs[:n_neighbors]\\n    # Control lejano: buena lectura (piso basal fiable) y lejos de objetivo y vecinos\\n    far = [q for q, d in dist.items() if d >= min_control_distance and q in info]\\n    if not far:\\n        far = [q for q, d in dist.items() if d >= 2 and q in info]\\n    far.sort(key=lambda q: (info[q].ro_err, -info[q].t1_us))\\n    cq = far[0]\\n    return Layout(tq, ti.t2_us, ti.t1_us, nbs, cq, dist[cq])\\n\\n\\ndef transpile_locked(circuits, backend, layout: Layout, optimization_level: int = 1):\\n    \"\"\"Transpila con layout fijo y SIN enrutado. Devuelve (transpilados, reporte_de_relevos).\"\"\"\\n    from qiskit.transpiler import generate_preset_pass_manager\\n    pm = generate_preset_pass_manager(optimization_level=optimization_level, backend=backend,\\n                                      initial_layout=layout.physical)\\n    tcs = pm.run(list(circuits))\\n    report = verify_no_relay(tcs, layout)\\n    return tcs, report\\n\\n\\ndef verify_no_relay(transpiled, layout: Layout) -> dict:\\n    \"\"\"Verificacion estructural de relevos.\\n    - Cuenta compuertas de 2 qubits (un SWAP transpilado aparece como 3 CZ/ECR, no como \\'swap\\').\\n    - Verifica layout inicial y final de cada qubit logico.\\n    - Verifica que la medicion del bit 0 ocurre en el qubit fisico objetivo.\"\"\"\\n    issues = []\\n    for i, tc in enumerate(transpiled):\\n        ops = tc.count_ops()\\n        n2q = sum(v for k, v in ops.items() if k in TWO_Q_GATES)\\n        if n2q:\\n            issues.append(f\"circuito {i} ({tc.name}): {n2q} compuertas de 2 qubits\")\\n        lay = tc.layout\\n        if lay is not None:\\n            try:\\n                init = lay.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True)\\n                fin = lay.final_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True)\\n                if list(init) != layout.physical:\\n                    issues.append(f\"circuito {i}: layout inicial {list(init)} != {layout.physical}\")\\n                if list(fin) != layout.physical:\\n                    issues.append(f\"circuito {i}: layout final {list(fin)} != {layout.physical}\")\\n            except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover\\n                issues.append(f\"circuito {i}: no se pudo leer layout ({e})\")\\n        for ins in tc.data:\\n            if ins.operation.name == \"measure\":\\n                pq = tc.find_bit(ins.qubits[0]).index\\n                cb = tc.find_bit(ins.clbits[0]).index\\n                if cb == 0 and pq != layout.target:\\n                    issues.append(f\"circuito {i}: bit 0 medido en q{pq} (esperado q{layout.target})\")\\n    return {\"ok\": not issues, \"issues\": issues, \"n_circuits\": len(transpiled)}\\n\\n\\ndef estimate_qpu_seconds(specs, backend, rep_delay_s: Optional[float] = None) -> float:\\n    \"\"\"Estimacion aproximada: sum(shots * (t_efectivo + medicion + rep_delay)) + ~2 s de overhead.\"\"\"\\n    if rep_delay_s is None:\\n        rep_delay_s = getattr(backend, \"default_rep_delay\", None) or 250e-6\\n    try:\\n        meas = backend.target[\"measure\"][(0,)].duration or 1.6e-6\\n    except Exception:\\n        meas = 1.6e-6\\n    total = sum(s.shots * (s.t_eff_us * 1e-6 + meas + rep_delay_s) for s in specs)\\n    return float(total + 2.0)\\n\\n\\n_ = np\\n'\n_FILES['circuits.py'] = '\"\"\"Construccion de circuitos DD con espectadores (vecinos + control) y tiempos alineados a dt.\\n\\nConvencion de bits: bit 0 = objetivo, bits 1..k = vecinos, ultimo bit = control lejano.\\nTodos los qubits del layout se miden en todos los circuitos, asi cada circuito aporta datos\\nde \"relevo\" (poblacion en espectadores) sin coste extra de circuitos.\\n\"\"\"\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, asdict, field\\nfrom typing import List, Sequence\\n\\nimport numpy as np\\nfrom qiskit import QuantumCircuit\\n\\nPROTOCOLS = (\"free\", \"cpmg\", \"xy4\")\\nBASES = (\"X\", \"Y\")\\n\\n\\n@dataclass\\nclass Timing:\\n    \"\"\"Restricciones de tiempo del backend (todo en unidades de dt).\"\"\"\\n    dt: float                 # segundos por muestra\\n    granularity: int = 16     # multiplo obligatorio de duracion de delay\\n    min_length: int = 64\\n    x_duration_dt: int = 0    # duracion de un pulso X/Y (para t_efectivo)\\n\\n    def us_to_dt(self, t_us: float) -> int:\\n        \"\"\"Redondea t_us al multiplo de granularidad mas cercano (evita los UserWarning de redondeo\\n        y garantiza que libre/CPMG/XY4 tengan exactamente el mismo tiempo de espera).\"\"\"\\n        n = int(round(t_us * 1e-6 / self.dt))\\n        g = max(int(self.granularity), 1)\\n        return int(round(n / g) * g)\\n\\n    def dt_to_us(self, n: int) -> float:\\n        return n * self.dt * 1e6\\n\\n\\ndef timing_from_backend(backend) -> Timing:\\n    target = backend.target\\n    dt = float(target.dt or backend.dt)\\n    gran, minlen = 16, 64\\n    try:\\n        tc = target.timing_constraints()\\n        gran, minlen = int(tc.granularity), int(tc.min_length)\\n    except Exception:\\n        pass\\n    xdur = 0\\n    try:\\n        q0 = next(iter(target[\"x\"].keys()))\\n        d = target[\"x\"][q0].duration\\n        if d:\\n            xdur = int(round(d / dt))\\n    except Exception:\\n        pass\\n    return Timing(dt=dt, granularity=max(gran, 1), min_length=max(minlen, 1), x_duration_dt=xdur)\\n\\n\\n@dataclass\\nclass CircuitSpec:\\n    \"\"\"Metadatos de un circuito del lote (se serializan en el manifiesto del job).\"\"\"\\n    kind: str                 # Por arista (a,b): Ramsey de a con b en |0> y |1>, bases X e Y, espera ZZ_PROBE_T_US.\n#     Δφ = φ(b=1) - φ(b=0) = 2π·ZZ·t  -> |ZZ| en kHz.  Sin compuertas de 2 qubits: el ZZ actúa en reposo.\nfrom qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile\nfrom qiskit_ibm_runtime import SamplerV2\nedges = sorted({(min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in cmap.get_edges() if a in POOL and b in POOL})\nprint(\"Aristas del pool:\", len(edges))\nt_dt = TIMING.us_to_dt(ZZ_PROBE_T_US)\nzz_jobs = []   # (edge, circuit tag)\npubs, meta = [], []\nfor (a, b) in edges:\n    for prep in (0, 1):\n        for basis in (\"X\", \"Y\"):\n            qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)\n            if prep: qc.x(1)\n            qc.h(0); qc.barrier(); qc.delay(t_dt, [0, 1], unit=\"dt\"); qc.barrier()\n            if basis == \"Y\": qc.sdg(0)\n            qc.h(0); qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])\n            tc = transpile(qc, backend, initial_layout=[a, b], optimization_level=1, scheduling_method=None)\n            pubs.append((tc, None, SHOTS_PROBE)); meta.append((a, b, prep, basis))\nzz_cost = sum(SHOTS_PROBE * (ZZ_PROBE_T_US*1e-6 + 1.6e-6 + 250e-6) for _ in pubs) + 2.0\nprint(f\"{len(pubs)} circuitos ZZ | ~{zz_cost:.1f} s QPU\")\nif MODE == \"hardware\" and t_total + zz_cost > MAX_QPU_S_TOTAL:\n    raise RuntimeError(\"El experimento 2 excede MAX_QPU_S_TOTAL; reduce POOL_MAX o las aristas\")\njob_zz = SamplerV2(mode=backend).run(pubs)\nres_zz = job_zz.result(); t_total += zz_cost\ncounts_zz = [A.counts_from_pub(res_zz[i]) for i in range(len(pubs))]\n\ndef expect(counts, bit):\n    n0, n1 = A.bit_counts(counts, bit); n = max(n0 + n1, 1)\n    return (n0 - n1) / n                          # <Z> medido sobre el bit (tras H, equivale a <X> o <Y>)\nang = {}\nfor (a, b, prep, basis), c in zip(meta, counts_zz):\n    ang.setdefault((a, b, prep), {})[basis] = c\nZZ = {}\nfor (a, b) in edges:\n    phis = {}\n    for prep in (0, 1):\n        cx = ang[(a, b, prep)][\"X\"]; cy = ang[(a, b, prep)][\"Y\"]\n        # bit 0 = qubit a (objetivo); la base Y mide <Y> tras sdg+h\n        phis[prep] = math.atan2(expect(cy, 0), expect(cx, 0))\n    d = (phis[1] - phis[0] + math.pi) % (2*math.pi) - math.pi\n    ZZ[(a, b)] = abs(d) / (2*math.pi*ZZ_PROBE_T_US*1e-6) / 1e3     # kHz\nprint(\"ZZ medido (kHz, |·|):\")\nfor e, z in ZZ.items(): print(f\"  {e}: {z:6.2f}\")","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-10T02:28:24.910718Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-10T02:28:24.911152Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-10T02:28:57.418906Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-10T02:28:24.911115Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-10T02:28:57.417684Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Aristas del pool: 5\n20 circuitos ZZ | ~4.6 s QPU\n","output_type":"stream"},{"name":"stderr","text":"/tmp/ipykernel_58/1604685260.py:24: DeprecationWarning: The SamplerV2 class is deprecated as of qiskit-ibm-runtime 0.50.0 and will be removed no sooner than 3 months after the release date. `qiskit_ibm_runtime.executor_sampler.Sampler` provides a new Sampler implementation that runs all the pre- and post-processing in the client side. adj[v].add(u)\n    rd = {v: len(adj[v]) for v in nodes}; alive = {v: True for v in nodes}\n    heap = [(rd[v], v) for v in nodes]; heapq.heapify(heap); Sset = []\n    while heap:\n        d, v = heapq.heappop(heap)\n        if not alive[v] or d != rd[v]: continue\n        Sset.append(v); alive[v] = False\n        for u in adj[v]:\n            if not alive[u]: continue\n            alive[u] = False\n            for w in adj[u]:\n                if alive[w]: rd[w] -= 1; heapq.heappush(heap, (rd[w], w))\n    Sset = set(Sset);
